result.reason: The operative payment clause reaches the preferred position by expressly eliminating minimum monthly commitments. However, Section 6 retains obsolete references to minimum monthly fees and related documentation/dispute carve-outs, creating inconsistency and ambiguity. In addition, requiring services to be both “ordered and used” may improperly excuse payment for ordered services that are made available but not consumed; “ordered or used” would better match the playbook. Conforming deletion of the Section 6 minimum-fee references is needed.
